newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Post-holiday Belgian shares firmer, await US data.
newsitem.headline: Post-holiday Belgian shares firmer, await US data.

text.p: Belgian shares edged higher in quiet trading on Friday, with many players taking another day off after Thursday's May Day holiday, and with eyes turned towards the U.S. where key monthly jobs data are due.

"There will be some nervousness in the beginning of the afternoon. Meanwhile there will be low volume and big spreads," one dealer said. "As usual these (U.S.) figures will give a little movement for half an hour afterwards."
The U.S. unemployment rate at 1230 GMT is seen steady at 5.2 percent in April and payrolls up 211,000 versus 175,000 the previous month. U.S. leading indicators follow at 1400 GMT.
